inspected_pages.observed: Author says one online video pilot and one in-person study; pilot uses six prerecorded Pepper direction videos over corn-maze video; 50 recruited via Prolific; response asks for preferred repair strategies.
inspected_pages.activity: pilot video ratings; not participant action following a live system instruction

inspected_pages.observed: Figure 1 is a physical blue-fabric maze; pilot Table 2 lists repair alternatives; in-person participants at a separate workstation direct Pepper following its spoken left/right options and path advice; do not infer video/stimulus equivalence.

Figure 2 shows a physical maze with scripted right/wrong suggestions; Methods describe up to three programmed wrong recommendations followed by spoken justification/promise/denial; validates operational communication in physical condition.
Author reports 60 recruited in-person; six between-subject cells combining two synthetic voices with three repair strategies, 10 participants per cell; not a separate sample count for each cell.
Table 3 reports differing acoustic voice features; visual page confirms no pure voice-human-likeness-only manipulation; investigator teleoperated Pepper rather than autonomous navigation.

Participant wore headphones at workstation, read subtitles, saw timer/battery display and made directional decisions by keyboard; .mp3 custom TTS or built-in Pepper voice was controlled by the wizard.
